Every language that you see on the Steam card of the game. If you can't find yours, write to use. Maybe we can add it later.

4. Will it have bundles with other games?

Yes, quite a lot. We will have a bundle with Tempest, War Mongrels, Gone Rogue, and a lot of simulation games.

5. What will I get in Early Access?

In short:
a) 5 missions
b) Around 6h of gameplay
c) Achievements

e) 20 character skills

b) More characters
